name: mark everything reachable, then free the unmarked
mechanism: starting from the roots, mark every object reachable by following references, then sweep the heap freeing every object not marked

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Mark and sweep' in section Distributed systems algorithms / Memory allocation and deallocation algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Mark-compact algorithm': a combination of the mark-sweep algorithm and Cheney's copying algorithm

requires: a stop or a concurrent protocol
fails_when: pauses proportional to the heap; fragmentation unless compacted
